purpose: Compare fixed local voice candidates on the same Mandarin words; all pronunciation checks remain pending.
providerNotes: Fixed preset identity does not certify accent, tone, pronunciation, or perceived speaker consistency.
Single-character words are difficult TTS inputs; no pronunciation is automatically approved.
Technical metrics and independent ASR are triage, not native-speaker or phonetic validation.
MLX community 4-bit conversion of Apache-2.0 Qwen weights; not the official unquantized runtime.
One bundled synthetic default voice; speaker identity, native accent and Mandarin tone accuracy are unverified.
Model-card Chinese support is not proof of correct isolated monosyllables.
MLX community multilingual v2 conversion, not the newer Mandarin-specific V3 finetune.
Technical checks and later ASR are triage only; every pronunciation review remains pending.
GenerationResult.token_count in this installed adapter counts input tokens; speech EOS and length are captured separately.
Input is exactly the selected character followed by a full stop; no carrier phrase, reading hint, crop, speed adjustment or tone manipulation is applied.
